text: Entry 1173 adds ten Google-token storage labels and tests those labels before making OAuth requests. Later 1307 removes the metric, collector and telemetry additions with a message saying they are no longer needed; its test file is byte-for-byte the original parent version. Accepted metrics and reportCalendars have no googleTokenType collector. The probe’s storage-layout observations remain historical evidence, not current telemetry behavior or proof of a performance/security regression. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.
